scored_object.description: Santa Clara County ZHVI (seasonally adjusted, all homes), maximum drawdown from the reference peak, measured on monthly prints through Dec 2028.
scored_object.reference_peak_rule: The series' all-time high as of the shakedown. At bootstrap (2026-11-01) that is Jan 2025 = $1,630,177; the Jan 2026 local high ($1,603,555) is NOT the reference.
scored_object.calibration_note: Base (-8 to -15) = the 2022-23 (-12.1%) and 2018-19 (-9.2%) magnitudes; Bear (<= -15) is beyond any rate-shock episode and needs a jobs shock; 2008 was -31.

scenarios.name: Bear — "2000 plus oil"
scenarios.definition: SCC ZHVI max drawdown through Dec 2028 of -15% or worse
scenarios.markers: S&P -25% or worse from the Oct 6 high; US recession starts in 2027; credit stays broken; mortgages >=6.75% through mid-2027; IPO window closes (ANT pulled or below issue); trough in 2028

scenarios.name: Base — "2022 rate shock, slower exit"
scenarios.definition: SCC ZHVI max drawdown through Dec 2028 between -8% and -15% (shallower than -15%, -8% or worse)
scenarios.markers: S&P -10% to -24.9%, chops; no recession or a shallow one; Fed peaks 4.25-4.50 and holds; 10-yr 4.4-5.0; mortgages 6.5-7.0; trough H1-mid 2027, flat into 2028

scenarios.name: Bull — "Iran deal + AI liquidity"
scenarios.definition: SCC ZHVI max drawdown through Dec 2028 shallower than -8%
scenarios.markers: Hormuz reopens; Brent <$90 by Q2 2027; CPI <=2.8% by mid-2027; Fed stops <=4.25; 10-yr <=4.3; mortgages <=6.5 by Q3 2027; ANT and SpaceX money lands; trough Q4 2026-Q1 2027, positive YoY by Q4 2027

partition_rule: Exclusive bounds: bear if drawdown <= -15; base if -15 < drawdown <= -8; bull if drawdown > -8 (shallower than -8).

weight_moves.label: chat Claude -> v1.1
weight_moves.readings_cited: brief Part 1.1 table (no stored readings exist yet)
weight_moves.reason: (a) the bear path is a five-link conjunction; (b) local labor, rents, sales volume and months-of-supply are all inconsistent with a crash regime today; (c) a steep yield curve and ~18.7x forward P/E argue against the 2000 analog; (d) the IPO calendar is a live counter-current. Bull is cut because it needs a Hormuz deal Iran currently calls unacceptable and a Fed that stops hiking with CPI at 3.7%.
weight_moves.opposite_case: Credit spreads at 2009 levels have never been noise; private-credit defaults at a record with a 2027-28 maturity wall; Alphabet -30% says the market has already begun punishing the build-out; the Fed is hiking into +29k payrolls, which is how soft landings end. If this move is wrong, it's because local data lags the credit cycle by two to three quarters.
weight_moves.reverses_if: Any one tripwire among {two consecutive months of SCC WARN workers >50% YoY, ANT pulled or below issue, CCC OAS beyond its 2010-2025 maximum} moves Bear back above 50. (Tripwire checkpoints are exempt from the three-dial rule, brief 3.4.)
